components.name: Spotlight Card
components.description: Signature bento card: cursor-tracking radial cyan spotlight and mask-revealed cyan border stroke, fading in on hover. Pointer position drives CSS custom properties on the compositor.
components.html:
Adversary-in-the-Middle

Real interception simulations against your live auth and session handling.
components.css: .ds-spotlight-card { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: #0a0f1d; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 1rem; padding: 2rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.04) inset, 0 20px 40px -24px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); --spot-x: 50%; --spot-y: 50%; } .ds-spot-fill { pointer-events: none; position: absolute; inset: -1px; border-radius: 1rem; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s; background: radial-gradient(600px circle at var(--spot-x) var(--spot-y), rgba(0,229,255,0.15), transparent 40%); } .ds-spot-stroke { pointer-events: none; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 1rem; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s; border: 1px solid rgba(0,229,255,0.4); -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(250px circle at var(--spot-x) var(--spot-y), black 30%, transparent 80%); mask-image: radial-gradient(250px circle at var(--spot-x) var(--spot-y), black 30%, transparent 80%); } .ds-spotlight-card:hover .ds-spot-fill, .ds-spotlight-card:hover .ds-spot-stroke { opacity: 1; } .ds-spot-content { position: relative; z-index: 10; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-spot-fill, .ds-spot-stroke { display: none; } }

narrative.overview: ProksiAbel looks the way a precision offensive tool feels in the hand: dark, dense, and machined. The surface is near-black volcanic glass that layers by luminance instead of shadow, and across that darkness runs exactly one live current — a single cyan signal that marks where the system is paying attention. The reference points are Trail of Bits, Linear, Chainguard, and Vercel: technical authority carried by tactile craftsmanship and surgical clarity, never by decoration. This world deliberately rejects the script-kiddie terminal mockup — no fake typing CLIs, no neon-hacker cliché. Credibility comes from restraint. Depth is built from four stacked obsidian surfaces, each a step brighter, with a hairline specular top-edge highlight that reads as machined metal catching light. Typography is a three-voice system: a tight geometric sans for authority (Geist), a humanist sans for readability (Inter Tight), and a monospace for anything the machine says (JetBrains Mono). Motion is spring-eased and purposeful, and every animation collapses under prefers-reduced-motion; a fixed fractal-noise grain dithers dark gradients to defeat OLED banding.
keyCharacteristics: Obsidian ladder: depth by luminance layering, not drop shadows.
One disciplined signal color (cyan) on <=10% of any screen.
Three-font system: authority sans, reading sans, machine mono.
Machined-glass detail: hairline specular edges, hairline borders.
Fonts self-hosted; no third-party CDN, ever (GDPR / privacy brand).

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Cyan Core appears on <=10% of any given screen and only as a signal — focus ring, live status, micro-badge. Structural surfaces stay on the obsidian ladder. If cyan is filling a large area, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Depth-By-Light Rule
rules.body: Elevation is expressed by moving up the surface ladder (brighter = closer), not by casting shadows. A raised element gets a brighter surface and a specular top edge, not a drop shadow.

rules.name: The Machine Voice Rule
rules.body: Anything the system states as fact — a status, a count, a badge, a technical value, a nav label — is set in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals. Prose is never mono; data is never prose.

rules.name: The No-Free-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow must earn its place by seating a raised surface or signalling focus. Decorative shadows are banned; use a brighter surface step instead.

dos: Do build elevation by stepping up the obsidian ladder (void->surface-3) plus a 1px inset specular top edge.
Do keep Cyan Core (#00e5ff) to <=10% of any screen — focus, live status, mono-badges only.
Do set every technical value, label, badge, and nav item in JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums.
Do self-host all fonts (woff2, @font-face, display:swap); the privacy brand forbids any third-party font CDN.
Do gate every animation behind prefers-reduced-motion and keep the fractal grain overlay to prevent OLED banding.
donts: Don't ship fake-terminal / typing-CLI / green-Matrix hacker cliches — the thesis rejects them.
Don't use cyan as a large fill or background; it is a signal, not a surface.
Don't reach for drop shadows as the primary depth cue — brighten the surface instead.
Don't set prose in monospace or data in prose; keep the three voices separate.
Don't reintroduce Google Fonts or any third-party CDN.
